g.text: The Ukraine shock cost the Netherlands about 310 lifetimes.
Each dot is one full 82-year life: life-years lost to lower income, summed over 18 million people
and divided by life expectancy. An equivalence, not a death count.
Method: CBS income–longevity gradient (8.5 years between richest and poorest fifth), 25% assumed causal
(range 10–50%), scaled to the period, March 2022 to the latest month. Central estimate after support.
